snlDoc.description: VS Code extension for SNL documentation with an Infoview webview panel.
snlDoc.settings.title: SNL Doc
snlDoc.settings.locale.description: UI language. Auto follows the VS Code display language.
snlDoc.settings.theme.description: Semantic UI color scheme. Auto follows the active VS Code theme.
snlDoc.settings.motion.description: Animation preference. Auto follows the Webview reduced-motion media query.
snlDoc.settings.formatter.indentSpaces.d: Number of spaces per indentation level when formatting SNL.
snlDoc.settings.formatter.inlineParenthe: Maximum parenthesis depth kept on one line when formatting SNL.
snlDoc.settings.popovers.openOnHover.des: Open Entry preview popovers on pointer hover. Primary click can still pin a popover when this is disabled.
snlDoc.settings.openBeside.description: Open SNL editor panels in a new group beside the current editor instead of replacing it. This is a layout preference, not a performance setting.
snlDoc.settings.trace.description: Log millisecond-resolution panel open and render timings to the SNL Trace output channel. Intended for diagnostics and disabled by default.
Show SNL Structural Index percentages below this threshold in red.
snlDoc.settings.structuralIndexGreenAtLe: Show SNL Structural Index percentages at or above this threshold in green; values between the two thresholds are orange.
